stories.title: GIVA raises Rs 975 crore to expand retail footprint
stories.summary: Bengaluru-based jewellery brand GIVA has raised over $100 million in a funding round led by Multiples Alternate Asset Management. The company plans to use the capital to build manufacturing capabilities and expand to 1,000 outlets. The deal includes primary capital, secondary transactions and an ESOP buyback.

stories.title: Arka Fincap secures Rs 525 crore from TPG’s Rise Funds
stories.summary: Kirloskar-promoted NBFC Arka Fincap has signed agreements for an initial Rs 525 crore investment from TPG’s Rise Funds. The deal includes a provision for an additional Rs 275 crore, contingent on the company meeting specific business milestones and obtaining regulatory approvals. Growth is the stated objective.

stories.title: From GIVA To EloElo Group , Indian Startups Raised $255 Mn This Week
stories.summary: Startup funding activity gathered steam in the first week of November. As per Inc42 data, 20 Indian startups cumulatively raised $255 Mn between November 2 and 6. This marks a 96% uptick from $130.3 Mn raised last week. However, deal count declined 38% to 20

stories.title: Clinics On Cloud raises $12.5 million for smart healthcare
stories.summary: Health-tech startup Clinics On Cloud has raised $12.5 million in a Series A round with participation from Dubai-based investors. The company intends to use the funds to strengthen its AI-powered healthcare technology and expand its network of connected smart clinics. Research and development are also priorities.

stories.title: O-Health secures strategic funding for edge AI hardware
stories.summary: Healthcare technology company O-Health has secured strategic funding from investors including Apollo Hospitals' Sangita Reddy and BugleRock Capital. The startup did not disclose the amount raised. It plans to use the capital to scale from an early rural healthcare prototype to broader clinical validation and research.

stories.title: Slayd raises $156,400 to automate fashion discovery
stories.summary: Gurugram-based fashion tech startup Slayd has raised $156,400 in a pre-seed round led by AJVC. The platform aggregates inventory from over 300 brands into algorithmic feeds for its 200,000 users. The company will use the funding to recruit engineering staff and grow its private-label apparel business.

stories.title: Funding and acquisitions in Indian startups this week [Nov 02- Nov 07]
stories.summary: This week, 28 Indian startups raised $258.1 million across three growth-stage deals and 17 early-stage deals, including two undisclosed rounds. stories.title: Six Gujarat startups secure Rs 287 crore in four months
stories.summary: Ahmedabad : Six Gujarat-based startups have collectively raised Rs 287 crore over the past four months, drawing investor interest in sectors ranging from hydrogen-powered drones and space imaging to artificial intelligence, insurance and travel technology. The latest fundraising round was secured by Cellegant Energy Systems,

stories.title: Pepperfry receives Rs 30 crore credit guarantee
stories.summary: TCC Concept has issued a corporate guarantee to support a Rs 30 crore credit facility for its subsidiary Pepperfry. The arrangement provides the furniture marketplace with working-capital finance. The company noted that the figure represents a sanctioned credit limit rather than an upfront cash payment or equity.

stories.title: Nominal triples valuation to $3 billion
stories.summary: Engineering software startup Nominal has raised $240 million in a Series C round led by Lightspeed Venture Partners and Insight Partners. The funding triples the company's valuation to $3 billion in eight months. The firm provides AI platforms for testing complex hardware like nuclear reactors and aircraft.

stories.summary: Hardware-testing and engineering startup Nominal raises $240M at $3B valuation Artificial intelligence-powered hardware-testing and engineering software startup Nominal Inc. today announced it has raised $240 million in new funding led by Lightspeed Venture Partners and Insight Partners. stories.title: geniosAI emerges from stealth with $19.1 million
stories.summary: Financial intelligence startup geniosAI has raised $19.1 million in combined seed and Series A funding. Led by FactSet, the round also included participation from Zoom and General Catalyst. The company provides software for corporate finance and investment teams to manage data for buy-side and sell-side workflows.

stories.title: Project Omega raises $80 million for nuclear fuel recycling
stories.summary: Project Omega has raised $80 million in a Series A round led by B Capital. The startup aims to recycle nuclear waste into power supplies for Pentagon hardware, including drones and satellites. The company intends to start fielding its expeditionary power systems for various edge compute applications.

stories.summary: Seattle-area startup Firmly has raised $15 million in a Series A round led by Squarepoint Capital, with participation from J.P. Morgan Payments and Mastercard. The company connects retailers to AI assistants, allowing shoppers to complete purchases within third-party apps without visiting the original merchant's website.

stories.title: African tech startup funding rises
stories.summary: African tech companies raised $684 million in the first nine months of 2026, a 30 percent increase from the same period in 2025. Nairobi accounted for 41 percent of the total, driven largely by Spiro’s $215 million Series E round. The funds were spread across 100 rounds.

stories.title: Bain Capital's Ajay Agarwal on the golden era of physical AI
stories.summary: Bain Capital Ventures partner Ajay Agarwal is betting on physical AI, drawing on his 2004 investment in Kiva Systems. Agarwal backed the robotics firm when it had no revenue, product, or customers, before Amazon acquired it for $775 million. The contrarian approach remains his preferred strategy.

stories.title: Venture firms eye equity in management platforms
stories.summary: Indian venture capital and private equity firms are looking to generate value beyond standard fees and carry. Fundamentum co-founder Ashish Kumar expects several firms to hold equity in their own management platforms to eventually list them. The goal is to hold successful companies for longer periods.

stories.title: Serena Williams rebrands venture firm
stories.summary: Serena Williams has renamed Serena Ventures to Starfire Ventures, shifting from celebrity-led angel investing to a firm designed to outlast its founder. Williams says the firm has backed 16 unicorns and maintains that her approach is based on expecting returns rather than handing out grants.

stories.title: Sequoia shuts down scout program
stories.summary: Sequoia is closing its scout program, signaling a shift in how the firm approaches deal flow. The model, which Sequoia pioneered 17 years ago, allowed founders and operators to write checks on the firm’s behalf. A consensus is emerging that the model has reached its limits.

stories.title: Sequoia to close London office
stories.summary: Sequoia Capital is closing its London office as it consolidates European investment activities into its San Francisco headquarters. The firm says the move is part of an internal restructuring to reduce organizational hierarchy. The decision follows two decades of international expansion for the venture capital firm.

stories.title: Internal friction follows Sequoia restructuring
stories.summary: Reports suggest Sequoia partners were blindsided by Roelof Botha joining the SpaceX board, deepening internal divisions. Following the closure of its London office and the end of its scout program, some staff describe the changes as an erasure of the firm’s heritage. Process is being debated.

stories.title: Series A funding grows as deal counts stall
stories.summary: U.S. startups raised $42 billion in Series A rounds through October, a 60 percent increase year over year. Despite the influx of capital, deal counts remain flat. Investors are increasingly bifurcating their strategies, writing larger checks for AI startups while delaying entry for others.

stories.summary: Researchers have formulated and operationalized a structured diagnostic framework known as the Venture-Ready Innovation Quotient, aiming to reconcile the long-standing divide between academic management theory and early-stage venture capital due diligence. stories.title: IINO Lines Invests in TMV Logistics Venture Fund to Back Maritime and Supply Chain Innovation
stories.summary: Japanese shipping company IINO Lines (Tokyo Stock Exchange: 9119) has made a strategic investment in TMV Logistics, a New York-based venture capital fund focused on maritime technology, transportation, artificial intelligence and critical infrastructure. The investment expands IINO Lines’ existing relationship with venture capital firm TMV,

stories.title: MakeMyTrip India IPO gets SEBI nod: Why the Nasdaq parent is listing the India arm | INDIA IPO
stories.summary: MakeMyTrip’s India arm has cleared an important regulatory hurdle for its proposed stock market debut. The Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) has given its approval to MakeMyTrip (India), bringing the travel booking company’s Indian business a step closer to becoming a listed entity.

stories.title: MakeMyTrip India arm receives IPO approval
stories.summary: The Securities and Exchange Board of India has approved the IPO for the Indian subsidiary of Nasdaq-listed MakeMyTrip. The company filed its draft papers in July using a confidential route. Proceeds are intended for long-term growth, inorganic opportunities, and the repurchase of various share types.

stories.title: Coca-Cola India bottler files for IPO
stories.summary: Hindustan Coca-Cola Holdings has filed draft papers for an IPO consisting entirely of an offer for sale by its majority shareholder. The parent company will not receive fresh capital from the issue, which aims to reduce the majority stake from 60 percent to approximately 45 percent.

stories.title: Hindustan Coca-Cola Holdings files for IPO
stories.summary: Hindustan Coca-Cola Holdings has filed draft papers for an initial public offering in India. The proposed listing will allow the majority shareholder to sell a portion of its stake. The company has not yet announced an issue price or valuation for the offering.

stories.title: Scripbox moves toward public listing
stories.summary: Wealthtech platform Scripbox has received shareholder approval to convert into a public company. The firm plans to list through a fresh issue of equity and an offer for sale by existing shareholders. Timing remains subject to regulatory approvals and discussions with investment bankers.

stories.title: OYO parent PRISM reports quarterly profit
stories.summary: Hospitality chain PRISM reported a consolidated profit of 353 crore rupees for the first quarter of fiscal year 2027. The figure represents a 17 percent increase from the year-ago period, largely supported by a deferred tax credit of 244 crore rupees.

stories.title: Honasa Consumer profit rises
stories.summary: Honasa Consumer, the parent company of Mamaearth, reported an 87 percent year-on-year rise in net profit for the second quarter of fiscal year 2027. Revenue grew 36 percent during the same period. The company continues to manage its financial performance amid broader market scrutiny.

stories.title: Tech stocks extend market rally
stories.summary: New-age tech stocks saw gains this week, with 54 of 69 tracked companies posting increases. The combined market capitalisation of these firms rose 5.2 percent to 169.3 billion dollars. CarTrade led the rebound with a 23.3 percent gain following a previous decline.

stories.title: Websol Energy reports quarterly growth
stories.summary: Websol Energy System reported a 73 percent year-on-year increase in profit after tax to 80 crore rupees for the September quarter. Revenue from operations rose 114 percent to 361 crore rupees. The company reported 91 percent capacity utilisation for its cell production line.

stories.title: Veritas Finance receives IPO approval
stories.summary: Non-banking financial company Veritas Finance has received approval from the Securities and Exchange Board of India to launch an initial public offering. The issue comprises a fresh equity offering of 900 crore rupees and an offer for sale of 1.28 crore shares.

stories.title: Sarvam AI appoints Google Cloud veteran
stories.summary: Sarvam AI has appointed former Google Cloud India managing director Sashikumar Sreedharan as president and chief business officer. Sreedharan will join the board of directors and oversee business across enterprise and government segments. The startup is currently expanding its commercial operations.

stories.title: Sarvam names Google Cloud India head Sashikumar Sreedharan as president & chief business officer
stories.summary: Indian AI startup Sarvam AI on Monday said that it has appointed former Google Cloud India managing director Sashikumar as its president and chief business officer (CBO). Sashikumar will additionally join Sarvam's board of directors. He will lead the company's business across enterprises and government,

stories.title: Nvidia board probes CEO conduct
stories.summary: Nvidia has launched an independent investigation into Chief Executive Officer Jensen Huang following his admission of an affair. The board is examining whether the CEO was targeted by foreign intelligence efforts. Shares fell 5 percent in premarket trading following the disclosure.

stories.title: RLabs wins Silicon Valley award
stories.summary: Pakistani startup RLabs has received the GOAL Startup Award at the Silicon Valley November Summit. The company works at the intersection of artificial intelligence and extended reality. It was selected from 18 startups to pitch ideas at the event organised by Plug and Play.

stories.title: Sarvam AI grants lifetime access to survivor
stories.summary: Sarvam AI has granted lifetime access to its models to Raghunath AS, a 70-year-old oral cancer survivor who lost his ability to speak. The company provided the access after the user publicly requested an affordable text-to-speech subscription on X to assist with daily communication.

stories.title: TCS concludes campus technology initiative
stories.summary: Tata Consultancy Services has completed 50 editions of its Tech Days initiative across 50 academic institutions. The programme reached 23,000 students and 912 faculty members. The initiative aims to provide students with practical exposure to enterprise technologies used to solve real-world business challenges.

stories.title: PhysicsWallah moves beyond test preparation
stories.summary: PhysicsWallah is expanding into AI tutors, regional languages and degree programmes to diversify beyond JEE and NEET preparation. The company is shifting toward technology-led delivery while navigating the challenges of monetising new products and improving offline economics. Diversification is the new test.

stories.title: Kerala AI center draws startups from 22 states
stories.summary: The India AI Center of Excellence in Kerala is attracting startup applications from 22 states. Founders are seeking access to technology infrastructure, industry networks and market opportunities. The center aims to position the state as a destination for AI-driven solutions. Geography is now an optional feature.

research.title: Aligning, Fast and Slow: A Control-Theoretic Oversight Framework for Long-Horizon Trajectories and Maintained Deployments
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: AI agents can pass checks on individual tasks while retaining memory or code changes that alter their later behavior. We introduce a control-theoretic framework that couples a fast loop controlling proposed actions with a slow loop. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: AlterNet: Adaptive-Depth Mixture-of-Experts with Learned Halting for Elastic Inference
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Most LLM architectures have fixed compute demands determined at training time. We propose a novel architecture that combines the Mixture-of-Experts architecture with shallow experts and a novel dynamic-depth system to make the extent of a forward. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Aspect-wise Pairwise Tournaments for Test-Time Selection
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Scaling test-time compute has proven highly effective at improving LLM reasoning. A popular method is best-of-n sampling, where a model generates many candidate solutions and one is selected. This motivates the question: how can we select. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: AttentionSwitch: Jailbreak Defense for LLMs via Joint Learning of Sparse Attention-Head Selection and Scaling
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language models have achieved remarkable performance across a wide range of tasks, yet they remain susceptible to jailbreak attacks that circumvent safety mechanisms and elicit harmful or unintended outputs. research.title: Cancellation Is Not Enough: What Retries Leave Behind in an Overloaded LLM Engine
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Clients and proxies in front of an LLM engine retry calls that time out. After a transient overload, these retries can keep the engine from recovering even when calls arrive below its capacity. Since the engine. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: ChainFlow: Few-Step Latent Flow Matching for Speculative Decoding
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Speculative decoding has become a standard way to accelerate LLM inference: a lightweight drafter proposes tokens that the target verifies in one parallel pass. Existing drafters face trade-offs that limits their speedups: autoregressive drafters generate tokens. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Debate to Deceive: Poisoning LLM's Fact-Checking via Game-Theoretic Multi-Agent Debate
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Knowledge attacks on Large Language Models, such as manipulating fact-checking judgments, pose significant risks to AI reliability. Existing approaches -- adversarial suffix/template injection and single-agent self-reflection -- lack robustness across diverse defenses and are prone to. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Decision Context: Persistent Behavioral Learning for AI Agents
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: LLM agents do not learn from corrections across sessions. A user fixes the same mistake at the start of every conversation. Existing agent memory systems primarily handle facts, such as preferences, entities, and conversational history, rather. Preprint, not peer reviewed.
